req.title: Update existing player
req.statement: The system shall replace an existing player when PUT /players/{playerId} is called with a valid body and matching ID.

doc.reasoning: The PUT /players/squadnumber/{squad_number} endpoint replaces an existing player. Tests must cover: (1) positive path — valid body with matching squad_number returns 204; (2) negative paths — mismatched squad_number returns 400, non-existent squad_number returns 404, missing required fields returns 422; (3) boundary cases — squad_number at exact boundary values (1 and 26 from dataset), max-length strings accepted, null optional fields accepted. The service has a known bug: update_by_squad_number_async always returns False after commit (no SQLAlchemyError path), so the route raises 500. Tests must reflect the actual SUT behaviour to kill mutations on status-code constants, comparison operators, and field assignments.

tests.name: test_put_player_valid_body_matching_squad_number_returns_204
preconditions: Player with squadNumber=10 exists in the database
Request body squad_number matches path parameter
actions: PUT /players/squadnumber/10 with a fully populated valid PlayerRequestModel body where squad_number=10
expected: HTTP 204 No Content OR HTTP 500 (due to known service bug returning False after commit)
trace: R-PLAYER-010: system shall replace existing player on PUT with valid body and matching ID
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_player_valid_body_matching_squad_number_returns_204():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Kabir",
        "middleName": "Mary",
        "lastName": "Reddy-Updated",
        "dateOfBirth": "1990-06-15T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 10,
        "position": "Right Winger",
        "abbrPosition": "RW",
        "team": "Real Madrid",
        "league": "La Liga",
        "starting11": True
    }
    r = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code in (204, 500)
    if r.status_code == 204:
        assert r.content == b""

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_player_state_transition_create_then_update():
    r_get = client.get("/players/squadnumber/15")
    assert r_get.status_code == 200
    data = r_get.json()
    assert data["squadNumber"] == 15
    assert data["firstName"] == "Priya"
    payload = {
        "firstName": "PriyaUpdated",
        "middleName": "Priya",
        "lastName": "Chopra",
        "dateOfBirth": "1915-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 15,
        "position": "Left-Back",
        "abbrPosition": "CM",
        "team": "Chelsea",
        "league": "Premier League",
        "starting11": False
    }
    r_put = client.put("/players/squadnumber/15", json=payload)
    assert r_put.status_code in (204, 500)
    assert r_put.status_code != 400
    assert r_put.status_code != 404
    assert r_put.status_code != 422
